text:
Alex Kim: proposing "queue strata" (fast / medium / slow) to reduce tiny-request SLO misses while keeping packing.
Priya Shah: admission rules? token-affinity?
Alex Kim: selector uses latency hint + recent tenant-tail score; token affinity scoped per-strata. cross-strata KV reads are read-through, writes gated.
Marco Ruiz: fragmentation risk — we could end up with many half-full batches and cost regressions.
Linh Tran: mitigation idea: short "donation" window where lower-priority strata lend headroom to fast for a bounded time. configurable per-host and per-tenant.
Samira Gomez: ops needs a concrete contract: donation duration, revoke semantics, metrics to validate.
Alex Kim: draft policy params (example): max_donation_ms=20, donor_threshold_pct=60, preemptible_tokens=8; also a per-tenant donation cap.
Priya Shah: KV cache warmup when tenants hop strata is a big tail risk.
Marco Ruiz: add per-tenant warmup credits; when moving to fast, spend a small prefetch budget to warm KV slots and charge it to an internal prefetch metric.
Linh Tran: telemetry surface: span tags strata, donated_ms, prefetch_tokens, kv_warm_hit_rate, wasted_tokens_by_strata. emit p50/p95 by tenant and model.
Samira Gomez: autoscale question — scale fast lane separately or overflow to medium?
Alex Kim: two-tier autoscale: fast scales aggressively for latency; medium/slow scale for throughput. overflow policy = prefer_medium then slow.
Marco Ruiz: fairness mitigation for abusive tenants: per-tenant donation caps, fairness windows, and a circuit breaker to block repeated donations above threshold.
Linh Tran: rollout plan: feature-flagged path, staged canary (dev -> staging -> 10% prod hosts), metric gates (strata p50/p95, packing_efficiency, token_cost_delta). rollback if packing cost >5% or tail regresses.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: feature_flag=adaptive_queue_strata_v1, canary=10% hosts, TRACE logs for selector 24h, runbook placeholder.
Alex Kim: action items: Marco -> selector prototype; Priya -> warmup mock and replay traces; Linh -> dashboards and synthetic workload; Samira -> runbook and staged rollout. 48h canary goal.
Priya Shah: will validate warmup budgets against replay of 1M requests.
Marco Ruiz: will prototype selector and post perf baseline numbers.
Linh Tran: will include quantized vs full models in canary matrix (prefetch cost varies).
Samira Gomez: ops asks to limit early exposure to non-prod and low-SLA tenants first.
Alex Kim: agreed. keep updates in this thread. if anyone prefers a simpler single-batcher soft-priority approach, speak up now.
